title: AORT I6 - measured recovery outcome (PROVISIONAL, NOT FROZEN)
description: What actually happened when a recovery strategy was executed against a controlled failure: measured RTO, the RPO exposure, availability during the incident, and whether the ledger still balanced afterwards. Linked to the I4 injection by injection_id. predicted_* fields are left null here and are for the recovery optimizer (Owner A) to fill, so predicted-versus-actual can be evaluated. Produced by infrastructure/recovery (Owner B).

injection_id.description: The I4 injection this recovery responded to.

strategy.description: restart_service: start a stopped container. unpause_service: release a frozen one. restore_from_backup: rebuild the ledger from the newest dump.

recovered_at.description: Null when the service never came back within the observation window.

rto_seconds.description: Measured: failure start until the service was observed healthy again. Null when it never recovered - never 0, which would claim instant recovery.

rpo_seconds.description: Data-loss exposure: how much banking activity sat between the newest usable backup and the failure. Null when not applicable or unknown.

availability_ratio.description: Share of probes that succeeded across the incident window.

transaction_integrity.description: balanced: debits equal credits after recovery. unbalanced: they do not, which is a correctness failure. unknown: could not be checked.
